versions.content: Service Name Icu_ Check Wakeup Syntax void Icu_ Check Wakeup ( Ecu M_ Wakeup Source Type Wakeup Source ) Service ID [hex] 0x15 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant (limited according to ICU050) Parameters (in) Wakeup Source Informatin on wakeup source to be checked. The associated ICU channel can be determined from configuration data. Parameters (inout) None Parameters None (out) Return value None Description Checks if a wakeup capable ICU channel is the source for a wakeup event and calls the ECU state manager service Ecu M_ Set Wakeup Event in case of a valid ICU channel wakeup event. Available via Icu.h
